about: TechCrunch tech and startup news. This CLI lists recent articles from the site's RSS feeds by topic category, tag, or author, and looks up single articles. Each result includes title, date, author and URL.

commands.summary: List the newest articles in a TechCrunch category, such as AI or startups, via its RSS feed. Returns title, link, author, pubDate and categories.

params.name: category
params.description: Category slug, e.g. artificial-intelligence, startups, venture, fintech, fundraising, enterprise, robotics

commands.summary: List the newest articles carrying a TechCrunch tag, such as san-francisco or generative-ai, via the tag's RSS feed. Returns title, link, author and pubDate.

params.name: tag
params.description: Tag slug, e.g. san-francisco, generative-ai, ai-assistant, unicorn

commands.summary: List the latest TechCrunch articles across the whole site via the main RSS feed. Returns title, link, author, pubDate and categories.
List the newest articles by one TechCrunch author via the author's RSS feed.
Get one TechCrunch article by its slug (the last path segment of the article URL). Returns title, author, published date, description and canonical URL.

params.name: slug
params.description: Article slug, i.e. the last segment of /YYYY/MM/DD/{slug}/
